subject: Post-call: Procurement & Marketplace path (AWS/GCP/Azure) - LumenAI
summary: Post-discovery follow-up to confirm procurement readiness and which commercial path LumenAI prefers (PO vs card) and interest in cloud marketplace purchase options (AWS/GCP/Azure). Includes pricing packet and marketplace guidance; next steps: provide SOW/quote and procurement onboarding links.
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Hayes <jordan.hayes@lumenai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-22T15:04:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call: Procurement & Marketplace path (AWS/GCP/Azure) - LumenAI

Thanks again for the call earlier today, Jordan — really helpful to understand your platform goals and projected usage patterns. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

- Scope: You want Redwood for inference across dev and production workloads, starting with a dedicated pool for high-throughput batch jobs and hosted API for internal tools.
- Procurement check: You mentioned Finance handles purchases and typically prefers PO-based purchases for contracts >$50k/year; card for smaller pilot spends.
- Marketplace interest: You asked whether AWS Marketplace (and GCP/Azure equivalents) is available as a procurement path to avoid lengthy SOW negotiations.

Attached: redwood-mpa-pricing.pdf (pricing bands + marketplace SKUs) and redwood-aws-marketplace-guide.pdf (how purchases flow via AWS Marketplace).

Immediate next steps I propose: 
1) I’ll send a short commercial summary / quote you can share with Finance (includes PO instructions and card option).
2) If you prefer marketplace procurement, we can prioritize AWS Marketplace onboarding (takes ~1-2 weeks from PO/commit depending on your procurement team).
3) If you require our MSA/DocuSign, we can loop Legal — typical cycle for similar customers has been 7–14 business days.

Could you confirm: 
- Who in Procurement/Finance should I send the quote to (email + any specific paperwork)?
- Do you prefer AWS Marketplace, or want GCP/Azure options as well?

Thanks — I’ll draft the commercial summary and share by EOD tomorrow.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.com
(415) 555-0186

Attachments: redwood-mpa-pricing.pdf (PDF, 520KB), redwood-aws-marketplace-guide.pdf (PDF, 310KB)

From: Jordan Hayes <jordan.hayes@lumenai.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@lumenai.com>, Aisha Tang <aisha.tang@lumenai.com>
Date: 2026-08-23T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Procurement & Marketplace path (AWS/GCP/Azure) - LumenAI

Thanks Camila — appreciate the recap. A few clarifying items from Procurement: 

- For initial pilot spend (~$15k) we'll use corporate card. For the production commitment (>$75k/yr) Procurement requires PO and a signed MSA.
- Marketplace preference: AWS Marketplace is preferred by our cloud team, but they also want to see if equivalent SKUs are available on GCP Marketplace (we run some infra there) so having both would be ideal.
- Contract timing: We can do PO issuance once we have pricing + the exact billing entity name and address. We try to avoid custom legal terms if possible; standard MSA is fine.

Procurement contact is procurement@lumenai.com — Aisha is on the thread and will coordinate the PO.

Can you share a one-page commercial summary we can attach to the PO request and the Marketplace SKUs (AWS/GCP/Azure) if available?

—Jordan
Head of Platform Ops | LumenAI

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Procurement Team <procurement@lumenai.com>, Jordan Hayes <jordan.hayes@lumenai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-24T08:46:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Procurement & Marketplace path (AWS/GCP/Azure) - LumenAI

Thanks Jordan/Aisha — noted. I’ve attached a one-page commercial summary and included the Marketplace SKU table below. If helpful, Marissa from our Commercial Ops is looped to provide the exact invoice/billing entity wording. Dev (solutions) is on the cc to confirm technical fit for GCP SKUs.

One-page commercial summary (attached as pricing packet) includes: 
- Pilot: $14,750 (one-month, card OK) — billed on invoice or card.
- Production commit: annual reserved pool at $85,000/yr (PO required).
- Marketplace: AWS and GCP SKUs available; Azure coming soon. Purchasing via AWS Marketplace uses a SaaS contract with vendor-aggregated billing and can simplify PO management.

Marketplace SKUs (high level): 
- AWS: redwood-inference.standard.1 (Hourly + metered token usage)
- GCP: redwood-inference.standard.gcp (equivalent pricing tiers)
- Azure: redwood-inference-preview (expected Q4 availability)

Requested from Procurement: 
1) Preferred billing entity name + address for the PO
2) Any specific PO reference fields (e.g., PO number format) and expected payment terms (Net30/Net45)

Attachments included: redwood-mpa-pricing.pdf (commercial summary + SKU mapping), redwood-aws-marketplace-guide.pdf

If you want, Marissa can send a templated SOW/MSA + DocuSign link once we have the billing entity.

Best,
Camila

---Quoted earlier---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-24T12:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Procurement & Marketplace path (AWS/GCP/Azure) - LumenAI

Camila — thanks for the draft. A couple of suggested notes to give Procurement that typically speeds PO issuance: 

- Billing entity: please confirm the legal name exactly as it should appear on the invoice. We list: Redwood Inference, Inc. / 185 Mission St, San Francisco, CA 94105 (we can change if you have a different address).
- Payment terms: default Net30 unless Procurement requests Net45.
- Marketplace vs Direct: If LumenAI buys via AWS Marketplace, billing flows through AWS (they will provide chargeback details). If they opt for direct PO to Redwood, we can accept PO + invoicing and support Net30. \
- Document path: we can send MSA via DocuSign (link below) and an attached SOW template for signature. \

Suggested language for the one-pager: "Redwood Inference will provide a dedicated inference pool and hosted API as described in the attached pricing packet. Pilot pricing is $14,750 (one month). Production reserved capacity begins at $85,000/year. Purchases may be made via AWS Marketplace or direct PO to Redwood Inference, Inc. Standard payment terms Net30. For marketplace purchases, billing will be handled by the marketplace provider per their agreements."

I’ve prepared a DocuSign envelope for our standard MSA to expedite signature: https://www.docusign.com/sign/ABC-123-DEF

Happy to jump on a 15-min call with Procurement if that helps.

—Marissa
Commercial Ops Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: Jordan Hayes <jordan.hayes@lumenai.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@lumenai.com>
Date: 2026-08-25T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Procurement & Marketplace path (AWS/GCP/Azure) - LumenAI

Thanks Camila/Marissa — this is perfect. Procurement will take the one-pager and attach it to a PO request. Aisha: please confirm billing entity and PO fields (Aisha: procurement@lumenai.com). Camila: please send the final one-page commercial summary as a PDF and the DocuSign link for the MSA. Also include the AWS and GCP SKU list in a single table for Procurement to attach.

Next steps: 
- Camila to send final PDF + SKU table (by EOD today)
- Procurement to confirm PO fields and timeline
- Marissa to prepare DocuSign envelope for MSA if Procurement requests direct PO route

Appreciate the fast turnaround — will circle back once Procurement has the PO queued.

—Jordan
